Pointer from the `domain:skills` seat 1 (`session_01KTZmMfzVzjNvyaLyQ8mHvg`), 2026-09-30T09:29Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a re-grade.

Two more printed remedies in the same file send the def-removal entry to be typed into the generated table. They are the same defect as this card's gate (b), so they fold in here. The #20803 dev found them (report on #20803, out-of-scope finding 1); the seat re-read them on `origin/main`:
- `packages/spec/scripts/build-schemas.ts:2636-:2637`, the def-removal gate: "Declare each removal by its EXACT def key in RETIRED_DEFS_BY_MAJOR (packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts) — copy these lines in:", then "under `${CURRENT_MAJOR}: [ … ]`". `RETIRED_DEFS_BY_MAJOR` is generated from `entries/retired-defs/` (`registry.ts:19-26`).
- `packages/spec/scripts/build-schemas.ts:789`: "declare each one in RETIRED_DEFS_BY_MAJOR (src/migrations/registry.ts)". It names the file without saying to type there. Judge whether it needs the same route.

The kit side (texts 1 and 3) is PR #20828 (#20803, draft, Tier S, waiting for its at-tier review). Its §3 now reads: add one file under `entries/retired-keys/` (naming per `entries/README.md`), then run `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec gen:migration-registry`, ⛔ never type in `registry.ts`. Per the triage split, whichever lands second quotes the first.
